extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Orchestrator with the Benefit Claims folder selected. The Connections tab is open, displaying configured Integration Service connections for Data Fabric, Gmail, and UiPath GenAI Activities. All three connections are listed with a green checkmark status of Connected.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Benefit Claims folder in the left navigation if it is not already selected. Click on the Connections tab in the top navigation. Verify that Data Fabric Connection, uipathlabs@gmail.com, and GenAI Connection are present and that each status shows Connected.
